text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: I wonder if Teach was watching...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I will. I'll show you where this life of ours
takes us.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
If this year is all you have left, I'll spend
the rest
of that time becoming your ray
of hope.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
(...My temples are throbbing, and I feel
this
burning sensation at the back of my
eyes.)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...We'll soon learn the results for this risk
I'm
taking.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: Festa!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Just hold on for me, Teach.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The next day, in front of the hospital...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Teach's room is on the floor above her
last one.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Heya, Tea—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: Festa... You're here...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa's teacher smiles gently
and
waves.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She sways her wrist slowly as her arm
remains limp
at her side. She must be in
pain. It seems like she's
been completely
still until this moment.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I look at both her wrists and neck. She
appears
smaller and frailer than before.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: Festa... I... Cough!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: Cough, cough, cough!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Sorry... about that... But, more
importantly, Festa...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: Cough! Cough!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...T-Teach?

text_block_list.name: Nurse
text_block_list.text: ...I'll run and get the doctor now!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: (Everything turns white.)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
(The nurse hurries franticly. Coach's face
is tense.
And Teach looks like she's in
great pain.)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: (...Is this the result?)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: (Is this the result... I wanted?)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Y-yeah.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Teach really only had a year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa appears completely
drained.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's probably the first time she's
witnessed
someone being so close to
death.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Was there any point?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I really thought I could change
something. I was
convinced...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
But nothing I did helped her at all. This
whole
time, the end was just drawing
nearer.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
She was living her last days... and what
was I
doing?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Nakayama?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! It's actually you. What're you up
to?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Jordan? What are you doing here?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I'm just visiting—or, I mean, I'm here to
get my
nails treated. Everything's almost
back to normal.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...I guess it's 'cause you inspired me.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, crap. I didn't mean to actually say
that...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
A-anyway! I feel like I shouldn't really be
here. So,
uh...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: See ya!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
What Tosen Jordan just said might be
exactly
what Nakayama Festa needs to
hear.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ack! What're you following me for?!
Shouldn't you
be comforting Nakayama
right now?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh? The heck does that mean?
choice_data_list: Your very existence is what Nakayama achieved!
Your very existence is Nakayama's result!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...I'm not ready to give in, and neither
should she
be.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I dive forward, reaching out to grasp
that
flickering light.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: My dream?
choice_data_list: I want you to tell them about your dream.
I want you to tell them about your dream.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Oh... Um...
choice_data_list: What does Nakayama mean to you?!
What even is Nakayama to you?!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Jordan? I thought you left...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
You don't get it, do you? You're the one
who said
you'd do your best even if it
means nothing.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: What you said, it helped me to change!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: What?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
You don't remember. Even though you're
the one
who taught me it wasn't
pointless. That's why I
decided to start
trying this hard!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
You made me want to put in the actual
effort to
be my true self!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
This may not mean much from an
Umamusume
who didn't even try to run
in the Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
But no matter what mean things other
people say
about you...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
You've always been a shining light to
me, so much
so that it made me super
jealous.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
That's when I knew I just had to beat
you.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
So, it became my dream, to one day
beat a Triple
Crown challenger.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I see a blue flame burning in Tosen
Jordan's eyes.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Jordan...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
You gave me all this hope, so... you have
to stand
up and act like it!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Be the strong Umamusume I know you
are, and
race against me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa's actions have changed

something after all. She's given hope to
one of
her peers.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Let's race at the Chunichi Shimbun Hai!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Click, clack... Click, clack...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We take a train back from the hospital,

Nakayama Festa stares out the window,
looking
past all the empty seats.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...She hasn't even won a graded race yet,
and she
just appeared out of nowhere to
challenge me.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: She's got no chance to win.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
She says she'll win because I gave her
hope...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: What the hell is going on?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
So what? Does that mean something like
I
shouldn't give up either?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Crap. Guess I'm running in the Chunichi

Shimbun Hai too.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We look up at the stars outside the
window and
make our wishes for the
upcoming Chunichi
Shimbun Hai.
